meta.descripcion: Portfolio of Francisco Alabau Calatayud (Xesco), Computer Engineering student: published apps, AI-assisted software development and automation. Play through it like a platform level.
muneco.etiqueta: Xesco's minifigure. Drag it with the mouse
inicio.pista.raton: Move with ← →, jump with Space, run like a ninja with Shift and drag the figure with your mouse.
inicio.pista.tactil: Use ◀ ▶ and Jump, hold Ninja to run, or drag the figure with your finger.
perfil.texto: Third-year Computer Engineering student with a Higher Vocational Diploma in Cross-Platform App Development (DAM). I focus on software development, automation and using artificial intelligence agents to speed up how digital products are built. I have hands-on experience building apps, automating processes and speaking about AI applied to education.
formacion.fp.titulo: Higher Vocational Diploma in Cross-Platform App Development (DAM)
experiencia.premea.texto: Built software that automates document generation.
experiencia.delaware.texto: Customer-facing job during a summer in the United States.
proyectos.texto: Four apps of my own, from idea to App Store.
proyectos.pista: Hit each icon from below to see its screenshots.
app.proximamente: Coming soon to the App Store
aldiax.frase: Learn to use AI with short, Duolingo-style exercises.
aldiax.p1: An agent refreshes the AI news every day and builds levels from it.
aldiax.p3: Available in Spanish, English, Italian and French.
yunque.p2: Home screen widgets to keep you on track.
yunque.p3: Everything stays on your phone: no accounts, no servers.
chatadn.frase: Turns a WhatsApp chat into a visual story.
chatadn.p1: Messages, reply times, most-used words and emojis.
chatadn.p2: 100% on-device analysis: your chats never leave your phone.
chatadn.p3: One-time purchase to unlock the Pro version.
neurona.frase: A party game to find out who's the dumbest in the group.
neurona.p1: 100 minigames in 12 categories; each game picks 5 at random.
neurona.p2: Rooms for up to 8 friends and a joke IQ at the end.
neurona.p3: Free with ads, or a one-time payment to remove them.
habilidades.texto: Each tower shows my level in that skill, out of 7. Climb them.
metodologia.texto: I don't tie myself to a single language: I work with artificial intelligence agents and an orchestrator agent that splits the work among cheaper subagents, to optimise both development and token spend.
metodologia.pista: Just like an orchestrator, the figure has just sent out its clones.

charlas.proximas: More talks at other schools coming soon.
